 OKLAHOMA WATCH: New federal tax credit offers Oklahoma public schools more opportunity, but donors have to wait 
 By Brenna Witchey 
 Nov 14, 2026 
 15 hrs ago 
 Oklahoma Watch
 Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... 
 President Donald Trump’s new federal education tax credit, written in 2025, has only temporary rules, even as the application deadline approaches. The delay could lead to taxpayers missing out.
 With approximately one month left before applications close, interested organizations such as Oklahoma Public School Resource Center are still waiting on exact guidance from the U.S. Department of the Treasury. If they don’t apply by the Dec. 15 deadline, their contributors will be ineligible for the tax benefit.
